26/10/18 - New Update:
 - Legality:
 - - Added: FireRed/LeafGreen Virtual Console transfer to HOME now recognized.
 - - Added: FireRed/LeafGreen Virtual Console legality checks enhanced (mostly around breeding egg move exclusivity).
 - - Added: Gen3/4 EV checks now verify that sufficient EXP was gained to obtain the current EVs.
 - Changed: WCS 2026 Greninja is no longer treated as expired; no end date is currently known.
 - Added: FireRed/LeafGreen Virtual Console Pokémon can now be converted from G

26/08/26 - New Update:
 - Legality:
 - - Added: Gen2-5 Recursive Egg Move inheritance checking to verify chain breeding movesets.
 - - Added: Gen4 My Pokémon Ranch IV reversal and improved LCRNG seed recovery. Thanks @StarfBerry !
 - - Added: Gen5 Global Link promotion language restrictions and additional Mystery Gift restrictions from card data.
 - - Fixed: Gen4 encounter generation and Egg generation, including correct Platinum learnsets and HG/SS traded Egg handling.
 - Added: Batch Editor now sup
- Added: Settings can now configure the number of rows the Encounter/PKM/Mystery Gift Database.
- The API reference is part of the help now, open to everyone

- Claude can now manage warranties, places, recalls, labels, coverage and collections, and look at photos
- Point to Settings → Claude & API, the section's real name, in the API description and MCP's error
- Help: troubleshooting, reverse proxy examples, memory needs, and a Claude and automation section
- Help: Ferret is in Unraid's Community Apps

- A 400×400 logo for directories
- Setup steps for AI agents connecting to Ferret's MCP server (llms-install.md)
- Sign in from Ferret's local address when PUBLIC_URL isn't set
- Portainer app template
